chapter: Reading, repertoire and New Orleans players
title: Leo Addy and New Orleans drummers who did not read
summary: Allen asks about Leo Addy; Bauduc says New Orleans players mostly played by ear and avoided corny Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
